import numpy as np
for lo,hi in [(0.2,0.6),(0.6,1.0),(1.0,1.5),(1.5,2.0),(2.0,3.0),(3.0,4.0),(4.0,5.1)]:
    m=(eps>=lo)&(eps<hi)
    A=np.c_[np.ones(m.sum()),T[m],T[m]**2]
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma[m],rcond=None)[0]
    r=sigma[m]-A@c
    A2=np.c_[np.ones(m.sum()),np.log(T[m])]
    c2=np.linalg.lstsq(A2,np.log(sigma[m]),rcond=None)[0]
    print(lo,hi,m.sum(),np.round(c,3),np.abs(r).max().round(4),"logfit",np.round(c2,3))
